annotations.title: Mark a campaign move done or dropped

description: Use this when the user says they did one of a campaign's moves (posted the reply, sent the pitch, put the page live, asked the creator) or want to drop one. done takes the day (YYYY-MM-DD, default today), where it can be seen (required for a page and a thread reply), and for a creator what was paid. Apptiller then reads it back and only marks it live once found. Nothing is sent or published by this tool.
name: mark_move
title: Mark a campaign move done or dropped
